sections.content: Use simple adjectives to give an opinion about an experience, then explain it with *porque*. For example, La *excursión* ha *sido* *interesante* porque *hemos* *visto* un *paisaje* bonito.

items.spanish: La excursión ha sido interesante porque hemos visto el paisaje.
items.english: The excursion has been interesting because we have seen the landscape.

items.spanish: Ha sido difícil porque ha llovido.
items.english: It has been difficult because it has rained.

items.spanish: Ha sido divertido porque hemos cambiado la ruta.
items.english: It has been fun because we have changed the route.
I think it has been interesting.

sections.content: Use *porque* to answer 'why?' and por *eso* to show a consequence.
